title: Graph Neural Networks
description: Graph Neural Networks (GNN): Graf yapısındaki veriler için deep learning. Node embeddings, message passing, GCN, GraphSAGE, GAT. Social networks, molecular property prediction, recommendation systems, knowledge graphs.

content.level0_basic: Graph Neural Networks (GNN - Graf Sinir Ağları), graf (graph) yapısındaki verilerde çalışan deep learning modelleridir. Graf: node'lar (düğümler) ve edge'ler (kenarlar). Örnek: Social network (insanlar=node, arkadaşlık=edge), molekül (atom=node, bağ=edge), web (sayfa=node, link=edge). GNN, her node için embedding öğrenir. Temel fikir: **Message passing** - her node komşularından bilgi alır, kendi özelliklerini günceller. Birkaç layer sonra her node komşuluğunu (neighborhood) temsil eden zengin bir embedding'e sahip olur.
content.level1_beginner: GNN'in temel bileşenleri: (1) **Node features**: Her node'un başlangıç özellikleri (örn: kullanıcı yaşı, molekülde atom tipi). (2) **Adjacency matrix**: Hangi node'lar bağlı (A[i,j]=1 eğer edge varsa). (3) **Message passing**: Her layer'da node komşularından mesaj toplar: h_i^{(k+1)} = σ(W · AGGREGATE({h_j : j ∈ N(i)})). (4) **Aggregation**: Komşu mesajlarını birleştir (sum, mean, max). (5) **Update**: Node'un kendi embedding'ini güncelle. Popüler mimariler: **GCN** (Graph Convolutional Network), **GraphSAGE** (sample komşuları), **GAT** (Graph Attention - önemli komşulara daha fazla ağırlık).
content.level2_application: GNN uygulamaları çok geniş: (1) **Social Networks**: Arkadaş önerisi, influencer detection, community detection. (2) **Molecular Property Prediction**: İlaç keşfi, toksisite tahmini (atom=node, bağ=edge). (3) **Recommendation Systems**: User-item graph, collaborative filtering. (4) **Knowledge Graphs**: Entity + relation embeddings (Google Knowledge Graph). (5) **Traffic Prediction**: Yol ağında trafik yoğunluğu tahmini. (6) **3D Meshes**: 3D shape classification (vertex=node, edge=mesh connectivity). Framework'ler: **PyTorch Geometric** (PyG), **DGL** (Deep Graph Library), **Spektral**. Modern GNN: **Graph Transformer**, **GraphGPS** (long-range interactions).
content.level3_advanced: İleri seviye GNN, architecture variants, scalability ve expressiveness içerir. **GCN**: Spektral graph convolution → spatial domain. Normalize: Â = D^{-1/2} A D^{-1/2}. **GraphSAGE**: Neighbor sampling (K komşu seç), inductive learning (yeni node'lar için generalize). **GAT**: Attention mechanism - α_ij = softmax(a^T [W h_i || W h_j]), önemli komşulara daha fazla ağırlık. **Graph Pooling**: DiffPool, TopKPool - node'ları coarsen et (hierarchical). **Over-smoothing**: Çok layer → tüm node'lar aynı embedding (bad!). Çözüm: Skip connections, batch norm, DropEdge. **Expressiveness**: GNN'in Weisfeiler-Lehman (WL) test kadar güçlü olduğu kanıtlandı. Daha güçlü: **Higher-order GNN**, **k-GNN**. **Heterogeneous Graphs**: Farklı node/edge tipleri (user, item, tag).
content.level4_expert: Expert seviyede, scalability, dynamic graphs, self-supervised learning ve production challenges önemlidir. **Scalability**: Büyük graf (milyonlarca node) için: (1) **Mini-batch**: Neighbor sampling (GraphSAGE), ClusterGCN (subgraph clustering), (2) **Graph partitioning**: Distributed training. **Dynamic Graphs**: Zaman içinde değişen graflar (social network dynamics). **Temporal GNN**: TGN, JODIE - temporal patterns. **Self-supervised**: Graph contrastive learning (GraphCL), graph augmentation (node drop, edge drop). **Pre-training**: Masked graph modeling (BERT benzeri). **Explainability**: GNNExplainer - hangi subgraph etkili? **Production**: (1) Inference optimization (ONNX, TorchScript), (2) Embedding serving (Pinecone, Milvus), (3) Real-time updates (streaming graphs). Research frontiers: **Equivariant GNN** (geometric deep learning), **Graph Foundation Models** (pre-trained on billions of graphs).

whatIsIt: Graph Neural Networks, graf yapısındaki veriler (G = (V, E), V=nodes, E=edges) üzerinde deep learning yapan modellerdir. Temel operasyon **message passing**: h_i^{(k+1)} = UPDATE(h_i^{(k)}, AGGREGATE({h_j^{(k)} : j ∈ N(i)})). Her layer'da node komşularından mesaj toplar, kendi embedding'ini günceller. K layer sonra her node K-hop komşuluğunu temsil eder. Matematiksel: GCN layer: H^{(k+1)} = σ(D^{-1/2} A D^{-1/2} H^{(k)} W^{(k)}). Node classification, graph classification, link prediction task'leri.
whyNeeded: GNN kritik çünkü: (1) **Graf verisi her yerde**: Social networks (3B+ kullanıcı), web (trilyonlarca link), moleküller, protein networks, traffic networks. (2) **CNN/RNN yetersiz**: CNN grid yapısı (image), RNN sekans (text) - graf için genelleşmez. (3) **Relational inductive bias**: Node'lar arası ilişkileri öğren (collaborative filtering). (4) **Drug Discovery**: Yeni molekül keşfi, FDA onayından yıllar önce toksisite tahmini. (5) **Knowledge Graphs**: Google, Amazon, Facebook - milyarlarca entity + relation. (6) **Recommendation**: Pinterest (5B+ pin, 500M+ user), Netflix (user-item bipartite graph). (7) **Scientific Discovery**: Protein folding (AlphaFold), material science. (8) **Interpretability**: Hangi subgraph kritik? (GNNExplainer).
realWorldAnalogy: GNN'i bir söylenti (gossip) ağına benzetebiliriz. Bir okulda herkes bir arkadaş grubuna (graph) dahil. Her öğrenci (node) kendi bilgisine (node features) sahip. **Message passing**: (1) 1. gün: Herkes arkadaşlarından (neighbors) duyduğu haberleri dinler. (2) 2. gün: Topladığı bilgileri birleştirir (aggregate) ve kendi bilgisiyle günceller (update). (3) 3. gün: Artık sadece direkt arkadaşlarının değil, arkadaşlarının arkadaşlarının da bilgisine sahip (2-hop). K gün sonra herkes K-hop uzaklıktaki tüm bilgileri öğrenir. **GCN**: Herkes eşit dinler. **GAT**: Bazı arkadaşlara daha fazla dikkat et (attention). **GraphSAGE**: Çok arkadaş varsa hepsini dinlemek zor, rastgele K tanesini seç (sampling). Sonuç: Her öğrenci komşuluğunu temsil eden zengin bir 'profil' (embedding) kazanır.

formulas: \text{GAT Attention}: \quad \alpha_{ij} = \frac{\exp\left(\text{LeakyReLU}\left(\mathbf{a}^T [W h_i \| W h_j]\right)\right)}{\sum_{k \in \mathcal{N}(i)} \exp\left(\text{LeakyReLU}\left(\mathbf{a}^T [W h_i \| W h_k]\right)\right)}
\text{Graph Readout}: \quad h_G = \text{READOUT}\left(\{h_i^{(K)} : i \in V\}\right) \quad \text{(sum, mean, max)}

stepByStep: 1. **Graf Oluşturma**: Node'ları ve edge'leri tanımla. Node features X ∈ ℝ^{N×d} (N=node sayısı, d=feature dim). Adjacency matrix A ∈ {0,1}^{N×N}. Eğer directed graf değilse A simetrik.
2. **Initialization**: Her node'un ilk embedding'i feature'ları: h_i^{(0)} = x_i. Eğer feature yok ise one-hot encoding veya learnable embedding.

3. **Message Passing (K layers)**: Layer k=1..K için: (a) Her node komşularından mesaj topla: m_i = AGGREGATE({h_j^{(k-1)} : j ∈ N(i)}). Aggregate fonksiyonları: sum, mean, max, LSTM, attention. (b) Node embedding'ini güncelle: h_i^{(k)} = UPDATE(h_i^{(k-1)}, m_i). Update: MLP, GRU, veya concat+linear.
4. **Normalization**: GCN gibi mimarilerde normalize et: D^{-1/2} A D^{-1/2} (symmetric norm) veya D^{-1} A (row norm). Self-loop ekle: Ã = A + I.
5. **Activation**: Her layer'dan sonra non-linearity: ReLU, LeakyReLU, ELU. Dropout: Overfitting önlemek için (DropEdge: rastgele edge'leri drop et).
6. **Readout (Graph-level task için)**: Node embedding'lerini birleştir: h_G = READOUT({h_i^{(K)}}). Sum, mean, max pooling veya attention pooling.
7. **Task Head**: Node classification: MLP(h_i^{(K)}) → class probabilities. Graph classification: MLP(h_G) → class. Link prediction: score(h_i, h_j) = σ(h_i^T h_j).

8. **Loss & Training**: Supervised: Cross-entropy (classification), MSE (regression). Semi-supervised: Sadece labeled node'lar için loss. Self-supervised: Contrastive loss (positive vs negative pairs).
9. **Inference**: Test graph → message passing → final embeddings → predictions. Inductive: Yeni node'lar (training'de yok) için de çalışır (GraphSAGE).
10. **Production**: Model serialize (ONNX), embedding database (Pinecone), batch inference, streaming updates (dynamic graphs), monitoring (embedding drift).
algorithm.complexity: **Zaman Karmaşıklığı**: Message passing layer: O(|E|·d + |V|·d²) (E=edges, V=nodes, d=hidden dim). GCN: O(|E|·d·d') sparse matrix mult. GraphSAGE (K neighbors): O(|V|·K·d²). GAT: O(|E|·d²) + attention O(|E|). Full graph: O(|V|²) naive, O(|E|) sparse. **Mini-batch**: Neighbor sampling → O(batch_size · K^L · d²) (L=layers). **Uzay**: Adjacency O(|V|² or |E|), node features O(|V|·d), embeddings O(|V|·d'). **Scalability**: Milyonlarca node için distributed training (GraphSAINT, ClusterGCN), GPU acceleration (PyG CUDA kernels).

codeExamples.title: Simple GNN with PyTorch Geometric
codeExamples.code:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch_geometric.nn import GCNConv
from torch_geometric.datasets import Planetoid

# Cora dataset (citation network)
dataset = Planetoid(root='/tmp/Cora', name='Cora')
data = dataset[0]

print(f'Dataset: {dataset}')
print(f'Nodes: {data.num_nodes}, Edges: {data.num_edges}')
print(f'Features: {data.num_features}, Classes: {dataset.num_classes}')

# GCN model
class GCN(torch.nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, hidden_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = GCNConv(in_channels, hidden_channels)
        self.conv2 = GCNConv(hidden_channels, out_channels)
    
    def forward(self, x, edge_index):
        # Layer 1
        x = self.conv1(x, edge_index)
        x = F.relu(x)
        x = F.dropout(x, p=0.5, training=self.training)
        
        # Layer 2
        x = self.conv2(x, edge_index)
        return F.log_softmax(x, dim=1)

model = GCN(dataset.num_features, 16, dataset.num_classes)
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.01, weight_decay=5e-4)

# Training
model.train()
for epoch in range(200):
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    out = model(data.x, data.edge_index)
    loss = F.nll_loss(out[data.train_mask], data.y[data.train_mask])
    loss.backward()
    optimizer.step()
    
    if (epoch + 1) % 50 == 0:
        print(f'Epoch {epoch+1}, Loss: {loss.item():.4f}')

# Test
model.eval()
out = model(data.x, data.edge_index)
pred = out.argmax(dim=1)
test_correct = pred[data.test_mask] == data.y[data.test_mask]
test_acc = int(test_correct.sum()) / int(data.test_mask.sum())
print(f'\nTest Accuracy: {test_acc:.4f}')
codeExamples.explanation: PyTorch Geometric ile basit GCN. Cora citation network'te node classification. 2-layer GCN, semi-supervised learning.

codeExamples.title: GraphSAGE with Neighbor Sampling
codeExamples.code:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch_geometric.nn import SAGEConv
from torch_geometric.datasets import Planetoid
from torch_geometric.loader import NeighborLoader

dataset = Planetoid(root='/tmp/Cora', name='Cora')
data = dataset[0]

# GraphSAGE model
class GraphSAGE(torch.nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, hidden_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = SAGEConv(in_channels, hidden_channels)
        self.conv2 = SAGEConv(hidden_channels, out_channels)
    
    def forward(self, x, edge_index):
        x = self.conv1(x, edge_index)
        x = F.relu(x)
        x = F.dropout(x, p=0.5, training=self.training)
        x = self.conv2(x, edge_index)
        return F.log_softmax(x, dim=1)

model = GraphSAGE(dataset.num_features, 16, dataset.num_classes)
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.01)

# Mini-batch training with neighbor sampling
train_loader = NeighborLoader(
    data,
    num_neighbors=[10, 5],  # 2 layers: 10 neighbors at layer 1, 5 at layer 2
    batch_size=128,
    input_nodes=data.train_mask,
)

print('Training GraphSAGE with neighbor sampling...')
model.train()
for epoch in range(50):
    total_loss = 0
    for batch in train_loader:
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        out = model(batch.x, batch.edge_index)
        loss = F.nll_loss(out[:batch.batch_size], batch.y[:batch.batch_size])
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        total_loss += loss.item()
    
    if (epoch + 1) % 10 == 0:
        print(f'Epoch {epoch+1}, Loss: {total_loss/len(train_loader):.4f}')

# Test
model.eval()
out = model(data.x, data.edge_index)
pred = out.argmax(dim=1)
test_acc = (pred[data.test_mask] == data.y[data.test_mask]).sum().item() / data.test_mask.sum().item()
print(f'Test Accuracy: {test_acc:.4f}')
codeExamples.explanation: GraphSAGE: Neighbor sampling ile scalable GNN. Mini-batch training. Inductive learning - yeni node'lar için generalize.

codeExamples.title: Graph Attention Network (GAT)
codeExamples.code:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch_geometric.nn import GATConv
from torch_geometric.datasets import Planetoid

dataset = Planetoid(root='/tmp/Cora', name='Cora')
data = dataset[0]

# GAT model with multi-head attention
class GAT(torch.nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, hidden_channels, out_channels, heads=8):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = GATConv(in_channels, hidden_channels, heads=heads, dropout=0.6)
        # Concat heads → hidden_channels * heads
        self.conv2 = GATConv(hidden_channels * heads, out_channels, heads=1, concat=False, dropout=0.6)
    
    def forward(self, x, edge_index):
        x = F.dropout(x, p=0.6, training=self.training)
        x = self.conv1(x, edge_index)
        x = F.elu(x)
        x = F.dropout(x, p=0.6, training=self.training)
        x = self.conv2(x, edge_index)
        return F.log_softmax(x, dim=1)

model = GAT(dataset.num_features, 8, dataset.num_classes, heads=8)
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.005, weight_decay=5e-4)

print('Training GAT (Graph Attention Network)...')
model.train()
for epoch in range(200):
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    out = model(data.x, data.edge_index)
    loss = F.nll_loss(out[data.train_mask], data.y[data.train_mask])
    loss.backward()
    optimizer.step()
    
    if (epoch + 1) % 50 == 0:
        print(f'Epoch {epoch+1}, Loss: {loss.item():.4f}')

# Test
model.eval()
out = model(data.x, data.edge_index)
pred = out.argmax(dim=1)
test_acc = (pred[data.test_mask] == data.y[data.test_mask]).sum().item() / data.test_mask.sum().item()
print(f'Test Accuracy: {test_acc:.4f}')
print('\nGAT uses attention: important neighbors get more weight!')
codeExamples.explanation: GAT: Attention mechanism ile komşulara farklı ağırlıklar. Multi-head attention. Önemli komşular daha fazla etki eder.

codeExamples.title: Molecular Property Prediction
codeExamples.code:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch_geometric.nn import global_mean_pool, GCNConv
from torch_geometric.datasets import MoleculeNet
from torch_geometric.loader import DataLoader

# ESOL dataset (water solubility)
dataset = MoleculeNet(root='/tmp/ESOL', name='ESOL')
print(f'Dataset: {len(dataset)} molecules')
print(f'Features: {dataset.num_features}, Task: regression (solubility)')

# Split
train_dataset = dataset[:int(len(dataset) * 0.8)]
test_dataset = dataset[int(len(dataset) * 0.8):]

train_loader = DataLoader(train_dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=True)
test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=32)

# GNN for graph-level prediction
class MoleculeGNN(torch.nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, hidden_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = GCNConv(in_channels, hidden_channels)
        self.conv2 = GCNConv(hidden_channels, hidden_channels)
        self.conv3 = GCNConv(hidden_channels, hidden_channels)
        self.lin = torch.nn.Linear(hidden_channels, 1)  # Regression: 1 output
    
    def forward(self, x, edge_index, batch):
        # Message passing
        x = self.conv1(x, edge_index)
        x = F.relu(x)
        x = self.conv2(x, edge_index)
        x = F.relu(x)
        x = self.conv3(x, edge_index)
        
        # Graph pooling (aggregate node embeddings)
        x = global_mean_pool(x, batch)
        
        # Prediction
        x = F.dropout(x, p=0.5, training=self.training)
        x = self.lin(x)
        return x

model = MoleculeGNN(dataset.num_features, 64)
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
criterion = torch.nn.MSELoss()

print('\nTraining molecular property prediction...')
model.train()
for epoch in range(50):
    total_loss = 0
    for data in train_loader:
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        out = model(data.x, data.edge_index, data.batch)
        loss = criterion(out, data.y)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        total_loss += loss.item()
    
    if (epoch + 1) % 10 == 0:
        print(f'Epoch {epoch+1}, Loss: {total_loss/len(train_loader):.4f}')

# Test
model.eval()
test_error = 0
for data in test_loader:
    out = model(data.x, data.edge_index, data.batch)
    test_error += (out - data.y).abs().sum().item()

mae = test_error / len(test_dataset)
print(f'\nTest MAE: {mae:.4f}')
print('Use case: Drug discovery, toxicity prediction!')
codeExamples.explanation: Molecular property prediction: Molekül = graph (atom=node, bond=edge). Graph-level prediction. Drug discovery için kritik.

codeExamples.title: Link Prediction (Social Network)
codeExamples.code:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch_geometric.nn import GCNConv
from torch_geometric.datasets import Planetoid
from torch_geometric.utils import negative_sampling, train_test_split_edges

dataset = Planetoid(root='/tmp/Cora', name='Cora')
data = dataset[0]

# Split edges into train/test
data = train_test_split_edges(data, val_ratio=0.05, test_ratio=0.1)

print(f'Train edges: {data.train_pos_edge_index.size(1)}')
print(f'Test edges: {data.test_pos_edge_index.size(1)}')

# GCN encoder
class GCNEncoder(torch.nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, hidden_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = GCNConv(in_channels, hidden_channels)
        self.conv2 = GCNConv(hidden_channels, hidden_channels)
    
    def forward(self, x, edge_index):
        x = self.conv1(x, edge_index)
        x = F.relu(x)
        x = self.conv2(x, edge_index)
        return x

model = GCNEncoder(dataset.num_features, 16)
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.01)

def decode(z, edge_index):
    # Inner product decoder
    return (z[edge_index[0]] * z[edge_index[1]]).sum(dim=1)

def loss_fn(pos_edge_index, neg_edge_index, z):
    pos_loss = -torch.log(torch.sigmoid(decode(z, pos_edge_index)) + 1e-15).mean()
    neg_loss = -torch.log(1 - torch.sigmoid(decode(z, neg_edge_index)) + 1e-15).mean()
    return pos_loss + neg_loss

print('\nTraining link prediction...')
model.train()
for epoch in range(100):
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    
    # Encode
    z = model(data.x, data.train_pos_edge_index)
    
    # Negative sampling
    neg_edge_index = negative_sampling(
        edge_index=data.train_pos_edge_index,
        num_nodes=data.num_nodes,
        num_neg_samples=data.train_pos_edge_index.size(1)
    )
    
    loss = loss_fn(data.train_pos_edge_index, neg_edge_index, z)
    loss.backward()
    optimizer.step()
    
    if (epoch + 1) % 20 == 0:
        print(f'Epoch {epoch+1}, Loss: {loss.item():.4f}')

# Test
model.eval()
z = model(data.x, data.train_pos_edge_index)
pos_pred = torch.sigmoid(decode(z, data.test_pos_edge_index))
neg_pred = torch.sigmoid(decode(z, data.test_neg_edge_index))

from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
y_true = [1] * pos_pred.size(0) + [0] * neg_pred.size(0)
y_pred = torch.cat([pos_pred, neg_pred]).detach().numpy()
auc = roc_auc_score(y_true, y_pred)
print(f'\nTest AUC: {auc:.4f}')
print('Use case: Friend recommendation, missing link prediction!')
codeExamples.explanation: Link prediction: Hangi node'lar arasında edge olmalı? Inner product decoder. Social network friend recommendation, knowledge graph completion.

codeExamples.title: Production GNN: Embedding Serving
codeExamples.code:
import torch
from torch_geometric.nn import GCNConv
import numpy as np
import faiss
import time

# Trained GCN model
class GCN(torch.nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, hidden_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = GCNConv(in_channels, hidden_channels)
        self.conv2 = GCNConv(hidden_channels, out_channels)
    
    def forward(self, x, edge_index):
        x = self.conv1(x, edge_index)
        x = torch.relu(x)
        x = self.conv2(x, edge_index)
        return x

# Simülasyon: Trained model
model = GCN(32, 16, 8)
model.eval()

# Simülasyon: Graf (10K nodes)
n_nodes = 10000
x = torch.randn(n_nodes, 32)
edge_index = torch.randint(0, n_nodes, (2, 50000))  # 50K edges

print('🏭 Production GNN: Embedding Serving\n')

# Offline: Pre-compute node embeddings
print('1. Pre-computing node embeddings...')
start = time.time()
with torch.no_grad():
    embeddings = model(x, edge_index)
embeddings_np = embeddings.numpy().astype('float32')
print(f'   ✅ {n_nodes} embeddings in {time.time()-start:.2f}s')

# FAISS index for nearest neighbor search
print('\n2. Building FAISS index...')
index = faiss.IndexFlatIP(8)  # Inner product (cosine similarity)
index.add(embeddings_np)
print(f'   ✅ {index.ntotal} vectors indexed')

# Query: Find similar nodes
query_node = 42
query_emb = embeddings_np[query_node:query_node+1]

print(f'\n3. Query: Find top-5 similar nodes to node {query_node}')
start = time.time()
D, I = index.search(query_emb, k=5)
latency = (time.time() - start) * 1000

print(f'   ⚡ Retrieved in {latency:.2f}ms')
for i, (dist, idx) in enumerate(zip(D[0], I[0])):
    print(f'      {i+1}. Node {idx}: similarity={dist:.4f}')

print('\n💡 Production Best Practices:')
print('  1. Offline: Batch inference → pre-compute embeddings')
print('  2. FAISS index: <100ms for 1M nodes')
print('  3. Incremental updates: New nodes → recompute neighborhood')
print('  4. Monitoring: Embedding drift, inference latency')
print('  5. Distributed: GraphSAINT, ClusterGCN for billion-scale graphs')
codeExamples.explanation: Production GNN: Pre-compute embeddings, FAISS for similarity search. Real-time node recommendation. Scalable to millions of nodes.

quiz.question: GCN nasıl çalışır?
options: Spektral graph convolution → spatial domain. Normalize: D^{-1/2} A D^{-1/2}
quiz.explanation: GCN: Graph Convolutional Network. Spektral graph theory → spatial convolution. Normalize adjacency matrix, mesaj geçişi. Basit ve etkili.

quiz.question: GraphSAGE'nin avantajı nedir?
options: Neighbor sampling ile scalable, inductive learning (yeni node'lar için generalize)
quiz.explanation: GraphSAGE: Sample komşuları (K neighbor seç) → scalable (büyük graflar). Inductive learning: Training'de olmayan yeni node'lar için generalize. Mini-batch training.

quiz.question: GAT'ın özelliği nedir?
options: Attention mechanism - önemli komşulara daha fazla ağırlık verir
quiz.explanation: GAT: Graph Attention Network. Attention mechanism ile α_ij hesapla, önemli komşulara daha fazla ağırlık. Multi-head attention. GCN'den daha esnek.

quiz.question: Over-smoothing nedir?
options: Çok layer → tüm node'lar aynı embedding (bad!)
quiz.explanation: Over-smoothing: Çok layer (>10) → tüm node'lar benzer embedding'e yakınsar. Information loss. Çözüm: Skip connections, batch norm, DropEdge, JKNet.

quiz.question: Graph-level task nasıl yapılır?
options: Readout (pooling): Node embeddings → graph embedding. Sum, mean, max veya attention pooling
quiz.explanation: Graph-level task (molecular property, graph classification): Readout ile node embeddings'lerini birleştir. global_mean_pool, global_max_pool, global_add_pool veya attention pooling.

quiz.question: GNN hangi problemler için uygun?
options: Social networks, molecules, recommendation, knowledge graphs, traffic prediction
quiz.explanation: GNN: Graf yapısındaki her veri için. Social networks (friend recommendation), molecules (drug discovery), recommendation (user-item graph), knowledge graphs, traffic, 3D meshes.

quiz.question: Production GNN challenge?
options: Scalability (milyonlarca node), dynamic graphs, embedding serving, inference latency
quiz.explanation: Production: (1) Scalability: Mini-batch (neighbor sampling), distributed (ClusterGCN), (2) Dynamic graphs: Streaming updates, (3) Embedding serving: FAISS, (4) Latency: Batch inference, ONNX.

flashcards.back: Graph Neural Networks: Graf yapısındaki veriler için deep learning. Message passing ile komşulardan bilgi topla, embedding güncelle.
GNN'in temeli: h_i^{k+1} = UPDATE(h_i^k, AGGREGATE({h_j : j ∈ N(i)})). K layer → K-hop neighborhood.
Graph Convolutional Network. Spektral convolution → spatial. Normalize: D^{-1/2} A D^{-1/2}. Basit ve etkili.
Sample komşuları (K neighbor) → scalable. Inductive learning (yeni node'lar için generalize). Mini-batch training.
Graph Attention Network. Attention α_ij ile önemli komşulara daha fazla ağırlık. Multi-head attention. Esnek.
Çok layer (>10) → tüm node'lar benzer embedding. Çözüm: Skip connections, batch norm, DropEdge, JKNet.
Node embeddings → graph embedding. global_mean_pool, global_max_pool, attention pooling. Graph-level task için.
Büyük graflar için: K komşu seç (örn: 10), tümünü kullanma. GraphSAGE. Mini-batch training, scalable.
Transductive: Sadece training node'lar (GCN). Inductive: Yeni node'lar için generalize (GraphSAGE, GAT).
Social networks, molecules (drug discovery), recommendation, knowledge graphs, traffic, 3D meshes, protein folding.
GNN framework: GCNConv, SAGEConv, GATConv, global_pool. NeighborLoader (mini-batch). CUDA kernels.
Pre-compute embeddings → FAISS index → <100ms retrieval. Batch inference, streaming updates, monitoring (drift).

commonMistakes.why: Over-smoothing: 10+ layer → tüm node'lar benzer embedding. Information loss, poor performance.
commonMistakes.fix: 2-5 layer yeterli (çoğu graf için). Skip connections (ResGCN), JKNet (jumping knowledge), batch norm, DropEdge kullan.

commonMistakes.why: Büyük degree node'lar var (örn: 1000 komşu) → memory explosion, O(degree^L) complexity.
commonMistakes.fix: Neighbor sampling: Her layer'da K komşu seç (örn: 10-25). GraphSAGE, NeighborLoader. Mini-batch training.

commonMistakes.why: Node kendini aggregate etmez → kendi feature'ı kaybolur. Performance düşer.
commonMistakes.fix: Self-loop ekle: Ã = A + I. GCN otomatik yapar. Veya UPDATE fonksiyonunda h_i^{k-1}'i concat et.

commonMistakes.why: High-degree node'lar dominant olur (çok mesaj gönderir). Low-degree node'lar kaybolur. Instability.
commonMistakes.fix: Normalize adjacency: D^{-1/2} A D^{-1/2} (GCN) veya D^{-1} A. PyG GCNConv otomatik normalize eder.

commonMistakes.why: Tek tek node encode etmek yavaş. Full graph forward pass her seferinde → memory ve latency sorunlu.
commonMistakes.fix: Production: Pre-compute embeddings (offline batch). Incremental: Sadece değişen node'ları recompute. FAISS ile similarity search.

commonMistakes.why: Graf zamanla değişir (yeni node, edge eklenir/silinir). Static model eskir, stale embeddings.
commonMistakes.fix: Streaming updates: Yeni edge → affected node'ları recompute. Temporal GNN (TGN, JODIE). Periodic retraining.

commonMistakes.why: Gerçek dünya grafları heterogeneous (farklı node/edge tipleri). User, item, tag gibi. Single-type GNN suboptimal.
commonMistakes.fix: Heterogeneous GNN: HetGNN, HGT. Node type'a göre farklı encoder. Relation-aware aggregation. PyG HeteroData.
